questions.question: Which is the largest source of irrigation in India by percentage of net irrigated area?
questions.explanation: Wells and tube-wells account for over 62-64% of the net irrigated area in India. Uttar Pradesh leads the country in tube-well irrigated area.

questions.question: From which barrage does the Indira Gandhi Canal (Rajasthan Canal), the longest irrigation canal in India, take off?
options: Harike Barrage at the confluence of Sutlej and Beas
questions.explanation: The Indira Gandhi Canal originates from Harike Barrage in Punjab at the confluence of Sutlej and Beas rivers, carrying water across the Thar Desert in Rajasthan.

questions.question: The Bhakra-Nangal multipurpose project is constructed across which river, forming the Govind Sagar reservoir?
questions.explanation: Bhakra Dam is a concrete gravity dam on the Sutlej River in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, forming the Govind Sagar reservoir. Nangal Dam is situated downstream.

questions.question: On which river is the Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme (RDS) constructed, which serves irrigation to Jogulamba Gadwal and Raichur districts?
questions.explanation: The Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme (RDS) is an anicut constructed across the Tungabhadra River.

questions.question: Under the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY), which pillar is dedicated specifically to promoting micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler systems)?
questions.explanation: Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) under PMKSY focuses on micro-irrigation technologies (drip and sprinkler) to maximize water use efficiency.
